# Top-level field names for the flat hl.* spec tables, extracted from
# Hyprland v0.56.0's shipped /usr/share/hypr/stubs/hl.meta.lua.
#
# Format: <SpecClass>.<field>
#
# HL.WindowRuleSpec / HL.LayerRuleSpec are deliberately absent: rule effects
# are passed as sibling keys that those classes don't declare (float,
# workspace, blur, ...), so a top-level membership check would false-positive.
# Those are covered by TestWindowRuleEffects/TestLayerRuleEffects and by
# TestHyprlandVerifyConfig.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
